from zipfile import ZipFile
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import re

path='inputs/scogs_animals.zip'

def parse_fasta(data):
    text=data.decode('ascii')
    recs=[]
    h=None; chunks=[]
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        if line.startswith('>'):
            if h is not None: recs.append((h,''.join(chunks)))
            h=line[1:].strip(); chunks=[]
        else: chunks.append(line)
    if h is not None: recs.append((h,''.join(chunks)))
    return recs

rows=[]
with ZipFile(path) as z:
    names=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft')]
    for n in names:
        recs=parse_fasta(z.read(n))
        lens=Counter(len(s) for _,s in recs)
        taxa=[h for h,_ in recs]
        rows.append((n,len(recs),lens, taxa, Counter(c for _,s in recs for c in s)))

print('alignments',len(rows))
print('taxon-count distribution',Counter(r[1] for r in rows))
print('length distribution',Counter(next(iter(r[2])) for r in rows).most_common(10))
print('unequal-length alignments',sum(len(r[2])>1 for r in rows))
print('taxon-label distribution')
alltax=Counter(t for r in rows for t in r[3])
print(alltax)
print('character set across alignments',Counter(''.join(sorted(r[4])) for r in rows).most_common(10))
print('max gaps per alignment',max((r[4]['-'],r[0]) for r in rows))
for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda x: (-next(iter(x[2])),x[0]))[:5]:
    print('long',r[0],r[1],next(iter(r[2])),r[3])
PY"

from collections import Counter
from zipfile import ZipFile

archive='inputs/scogs_animals.zip'
valid=set('ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY')
rows=[]
with ZipFile(archive) as z:
    members=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft')]
    assert len(members)==241, len(members)
    for name in members:
        records=[]
        header=None
        seq=[]
        for line in z.read(name).decode('ascii').splitlines():
            if line.startswith('>'):
                if header is not None:
                    records.append((header,''.join(seq)))
                header=line[1:].strip(); seq=[]
            elif line.strip():
                seq.append(line.strip())
        if header is not None:
            records.append((header,''.join(seq)))
        assert records and all(s for _,s in records), name
        lengths={len(s) for _,s in records}
        assert len(lengths)==1, (name,lengths)
        assert all(set(s)<=valid|{'-'} for _,s in records), name
        seqs=[s for _,s in records]
        informative=0
        for column in zip(*seqs):
            observed=Counter(c for c in column if c"'!='"'-')
            if sum(count>=2 for count in observed.values())>=2:
                informative += 1
        # Independent equivalent check on residue-pattern multiplicities.
        informative2=sum(
            1 for column in zip(*seqs)
            if len([n for n in Counter(c for c in column if c"'!='"'-').values() if n>=2])>=2
        )
        assert informative==informative2
        rows.append((informative,name,len(seqs),len(seqs[0])))

best=max(v for v,*_ in rows)
ties=sorted((name,n,L) for v,name,n,L in rows if v==best)
assert best==29, best
assert ties==[
    ('1428854at2759.faa.mafft',4,1021),
    ('570797at2759.faa.mafft',4,903),
], ties
print('PASS alignments=241; max_pis=%d; ties=%s' % (best, ties))
PY"
